scenes.narration: {APL|@apl} made arrays and math the basic vocabulary of a language. {J|Jay} explored an {ASCII|ass key} notation, and powerful function composition. {K|Kay} kept a compact vocabulary, and short expressions. After them, {BQN|@bqn} revisited many of these ideas, with a modern notation and combinators. {X_eTaL|@xtl} takes ideas from this family, but makes different choices.
